summary: Biophytis S.A., a French clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company listed on Nasdaq and Euronext, furnished a Form 6-K on November 2, 2026, attaching its Half-Year Financial Report issued October 30, 2026 (an interim results disclosure equivalent to a US periodic report). The filing contains no transaction terms—no stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock—and no special-situation event; it is a routine foreign private issuer interim reporting submission. Watch items are cash runway and financing dilution risk typical for a micro-cap biotech rather than any deal-arbitrage angle.
